question: What must one know and worship after locating these wheel-situated goddesses?
premises: etāḥ cakrasthitāḥ sarvāḥ are all wheel-situated
sthānaṃ jñātvā means knowing their place
inference: One should know their place and then worship them well.
plain_english: Knowing their place, one should worship all these wheel-situated goddesses well.
